name: alpha_s_inv_bare
app_psc_label: Strong coupling α_s⁻¹(bare) = 10 φ² (Tier 3 calibrated handle)
formula: α_s⁻¹(bare) = 10 · φ² (10 = RT three-fold axes; φ² = icosahedral inflation)
tier: Tier 3 calibrated handle (10 integer + φ² geometric factor); O.42 / QLQCD-2 open + Tier 4 as evidence that phi explains the value (constant control test v3 NEGATIVE-FRAGILE; App PSC §PSC.9.6)
app_psc_precision_str: Tier 3 calibrated-handle evaluation: 10 · φ² = 26.1803 vs stated 26.18 (+0.0013%). Gap to PDG α_s⁻¹(M_Z) = 8.4746 is +208.9% under the (bare⁻¹ - M_Z⁻¹)/M_Z⁻¹ convention; in direct-coupling space, α_s(M_Z) exceeds α_s(bare) by 67.63% when normalized to α_s(M_Z). This is the open debt of App GRF §GRF.5 / Ch04 §4.5.5 (QLQCD-2 non-perturbative confinement correction, App QLA.7 open problem).

extra.derivation_note: α_s⁻¹(bare) = 10 φ² combines two geometric substrate inputs: (a) the count of three-fold rotation axes of the rhombic triacontahedron = 10, and (b) the icosahedral inflation factor φ². The TREE-LEVEL bare value 26.18 is a calibrated handle at M_GUT; the inverse-space +208.9% residual to PDG 2024 α_s⁻¹(M_Z) = 8.475 uses the observed inverse coupling as denominator. The direct-space 67.63% comparison is separately labelled. Both compare a GUT-scale handle with an M_Z value and so mix scales; the native run gives α_s(M_Z) ≈ 0.052 (55.9% low). The gap is the open QLQCD-2 non-perturbative confinement debt (App QLA.7), explicitly acknowledged in App GRF §GRF.5 and Ch04 §4.5.5. Non-perturbative closure remains pending.
